Looma

A conversational AI companion that makes logging expenses and understanding spending feel simple and supportive.

Personal finance · Mobile app

Read overview
OverviewDesign process & screensMore projects

The challenge

Managing personal finances can feel stressful and confusing, especially for young adults balancing multiple expenses.

The users

Looma is designed for young professionals and students who want to understand their money without being overwhelmed by complex tools.

The direction

The concept introduces a conversational AI companion for logging, tracking, and visualising expenses, supported by a guided onboarding experience.
